What's new in DuckOS 1.0.64

• Home screen: put apps anywhere. Hold an app and drag it to any spot — gaps allowed; the others flow around it. Drag an app straight out of the app drawer onto the home screen too.
• The app drawer follows your finger as you swipe up (the home frosts over as it comes), opens when you let go far enough, or slides back down.
• The ring moves up and makes room when the home screen has more rows of apps.
